Cloudflare's free images ran out mid-run (my mistake: one Lucid hero shot used 5,400 of the 10,000 daily neurons, and it came back with a face anyway, so it was dropped). Five replacement stills were made free with SDXL on GitHub Actions. Nothing was paid.
